title: Rory and the Amber Hill
verses:
The sun had set behind the woods,
The stars began to gleam,
While Rory led his sleepy friends
Beside an amber stream.

Above the hills, high in the sky,
Nia glided on the breeze,
She found a hill of nodding flowers
Beneath the cedar trees.

Ricky stopped his bouncy hops
Upon the starry ground,
And Benny lowered down his head
Without a single sound.

Tilly made a cushion soft
Of clover in a heap,
While Psittaco curled in her frill
And snuggled down to sleep.

Then Rory yawned a happy yawn
And stretched his tail out wide,
He curled into the fragrant grass
With Benny by his side.

The fireflies began to dance,
The silver moon shone bright,
And all the dinosaurs were still,
To dream away the night.
